name: Pung
description: Pung runs Schwung modules (the module ecosystem of Ableton Move) on Push 3 as devices in Live: instruments, audio effects and MIDI effects in Push's browser and device view, with Pung's own view on the Push screen, on Push Hack's Live device layer (core/livedevice). Needs Push Manager's VST3 scan switched on.
author: rgeissen
